arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the model whose output is the scores of the classes for each pixel, empty for PP-HumanSeg of opencv_zoo

arg.name: classes
arg.description: Path or URL of the class names of the model, one name per line, the first one is the background, or empty for background and person of PP-HumanSeg

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: scale
arg.description: Multiplier of the pixel values for the network input

arg.name: mean
arg.description: Mean subtracted from the pixel values before the scale

arg.name: swap_rb
arg.description: Swap the red and blue channels, true for the models trained in RGB
